peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE MECHANISM, NOT THE CURRENT DEVIATION. This scores how the peg is defended — PegKeeper arbitrage, the soft-liquidation AMM and the redemption path — not whether crvUSD is at par today. PERSISTENCE-FILTERED: it does not move on a spot reading. A live band showing par tells a reader the mechanism is working right now; this asks whether it holds under stress it has not yet met.

backing.backing_score_basis: MEASURES RESERVE COMPOSITION AND ITS CONCENTRATION, not the live collateral ratio. ⚠️ EXPLICIT PERSISTENCE RULE: cut below 5.0 only if total_pegkeeper_debt / total_supply holds above 25% for MORE THAN 5 CONSECUTIVE DAILY READINGS. A four-day excursion with the peg at par is the mechanism working, not a deterioration. The rule has been applied against itself: a 2026-08-24 cut to 4.5 was REVERSED on 2026-09-07 because it had been made at the peak of a four-day transient that would not have fired the rule. Current reading 6.8%, well under the line.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — 25% threshold over >5 consecutive daily readings

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES THE DOLLAR EXIT SPECIFICALLY, which is why it sits below a live depth band. ⚠️ NOT ONE YieldBasis cryptopool pairs crvUSD with a dollar — all eight are WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC or WETH — so selling into them leaves a holder in BTC or ETH. One-hop dollar exit is $27.68M, 11.91% of issuance-side supply; the two-hop BTC/ETH route is $144.8M and is a REAL exit, just not a dollar one. A live band aggregating both answers a different question from the one a seller asks. PERSISTENCE-FILTERED: prices the standing venue structure, not a daily depth quote.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue structure, not spot depth

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: MEASURES COUNTERPARTY CONCENTRATION IN THE SUPPLY ARCHITECTURE — who crvUSD relies on to exist, not whether it is backed. One counterparty holds a $1,000,000,000 facility, fully drawn: 47.51% of all crvUSD in existence on a raw-supply basis, or roughly 51% of what actually circulates on an issuance basis. BOTH ARE TRUE AND THEY ANSWER DIFFERENT QUESTIONS — a line versus a drawing — and they cannot share a denominator because $669.3M of the facility never entered circulation. Bounded: headroom to mint is ZERO, so the fast path reallocates rather than creates. ⚠️ COVERAGE LIMIT: ~18.3% of supply comes from mint authorities not enumerable without archive logs.
dependencies.underlying_score_persistence: filtered — supply architecture, not a daily balance
